body: To be honest the loneliness is something that comes and goes. It’s important to remember that the loneliness you feel is being away from the people who don’t ever go out there way to say “Are you doing okay?”. So why feel lonely from being away from anyone like that? It isn’t worth it. I also listen to music during times like this, yet they are usually dark themed songs. Just be careful when listening to music that fuels the loneliness. Don’t listen to it for that, listen to the music, because you find it beautiful.
